list.title: AI providers
list.intro: Add the provider the partner should use. Your key stays in this browser.
list.empty: No provider yet. Add one to turn the partner on.
list.removeAsk: Remove {label}? Its key is deleted too.
list.limit: You can keep up to {count} providers.
list.notPersisted: This browser cannot keep providers after the tab closes.

legacy.failed: Could not move the saved key. Try again.

form.label: Name
form.baseUrlHint: The web address up to the version, for example https://api.openai.com/v1
form.keyHint: Kept in this browser and never shown again.
form.keyKeep: Leave blank to keep the saved key.
form.keyLocal: This provider runs on your computer and needs no key.
form.keyBad: The key must be 8 to 512 visible characters.
form.priceBoth: Fill in both prices or neither.
form.priceStale: This price is from {date}. Check it with the provider.

test.title: Test results
test.toolsOff: Tools: off for this provider. The partner can answer, but it cannot read your project with tools.
test.csp: This site's policy does not allow that address. Add it to IYNK_CONNECT_ORIGINS and restart the web container.
test.error: The test could not run. Try again.

caps.title: Spending limits
caps.hint: Leave a field blank for the default. Type {word} to remove a limit. 0 is not accepted.
caps.zero: 0 is not accepted. Type {word} to remove the limit.

prices.stale: Price table dated {date}. It is more than 90 days old, so check prices with your provider.

data.ask: Delete every conversation, log and usage count? Your keys stay.
data.failed: Could not delete the AI data. Try again.

notes.relay: If you use a friend's server as the relay, your key passes through their machine for each call.
notes.cap: The spending limits count in this browser only, so set a limit with your provider too.
